title: Check vehicles eligible for motor vehicle tax concession
summary: Find out if your vehicle is eligible for a concession on motor vehicle tax because it has a lower environmental impact.
intro:
Vehicles that have a lower impact on the environment can get a concession on motor vehicle tax.

These lower taxed vehicles include:

Private vehicles that have been modified for wheelchair transport may be eligible for the reduced vehicle tax rate.

The reduced rate is applied when you register the vehicle.

Note: If you receive the Commonwealth Carer Allowance, you may also be eligible. Visit Apply for a carer's registration refund for more information.
who_can_apply: Vehicles that have a lower impact on the environment.
Private vehicles modified for wheelchair transport.

faqs.q: What types of vehicles can receive a motor vehicle tax concession?
faqs.a: Vehicles that have a lower impact on the environment may be eligible for a concession on motor vehicle tax.

faqs.q: Am I eligible for a reduced vehicle tax rate if I use a modified vehicle for wheelchair transport?
faqs.a: Private vehicles that have been modified for wheelchair transport may be eligible for the reduced vehicle tax rate when you register the vehicle.

faqs.q: Can receiving the Commonwealth Carer Allowance make me eligible for a concession?
faqs.a: If you receive the Commonwealth Carer Allowance, you may also be eligible for a concession. You can visit the Apply for a carer's registration refund page for more information.
